stem:
The table represents some points on the graph of an exponential function.

\begin{tabular}{|c|c|}
\hline
x & P(x) \\
\hline
-1 & 270 \\
0 & 90 \\
1 & 30 \\
2 & 10 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

Which function represents the relation shown in the table?
visual_elements: table with x values -1, 0, 1, 2 and corresponding P(x) values 270, 90, 30, 10
